api_basics.details: RESTful JSON API — standard HTTP verbs (GET, POST), JSON request/response bodies, HTTP status codes for errors.
Most application endpoints are under /api/ (plus /health for service checks).
HTTP errors return a detail message (FastAPI HTTPException).

endpoints.description: List account summaries including equity, benchmark, PnL deltas, latest snapshot timing, and live benchmark summary fields when available.
Return all accounts with live equity stats, live benchmark return/alpha summaries, and latest backtest metrics for side-by-side comparison.
Return ordered option values and defaults for the account configuration editor.
Get one account detail including positions, latest backtest summary, recent snapshots, recent trades, and liveBenchmarkOverlay data.

Partially update one book's execution, universe, and rotation settings. All fields are optional — omitted fields are left unchanged. Rotation scheduling and rotation policy are separate groups on the same request.
Partially update mutable account config, options, goals, and rotation settings.
Create equity snapshots for all managed accounts.
Create an equity snapshot for one account.
Return list of managed accounts with book summary and latest run status.

Return comprehensive autonomy dashboard data for a managed account. Includes: - Account overview (total equity, cash, positions) - Book status and performance metrics - Latest daily workflow run details - Governance check status (W1-W3, M1-M3) - Burn-in progress - Recent rotations - Risk summary (kill switch, violations)
Simple health check. Returns {"status":"ok"} when backend is up.
Return account analysis including account return, benchmark return, alpha, PnL splits, top winners/losers, and improvement notes.
Cross-account portfolio rollup: exposure per account plus symbol/sector concentration.
Run the feature-driven signal helpers for a ticker and return provider-specific signal/context payloads.
Return health/status details for the UI alt-strategy feature providers.
Create a new account with core fields, risk policy, options settings, and rotation settings.
Delete an account and its dependent data after explicit confirmation.
Return account identity details for confirmation before deletion.
Return current runtime job health, recent artifacts, and backup visibility.
Return effective global, per-book, and strategy parameters with database/default source attribution.
Return promotion readiness plus persisted review history for one account.
Return available .log files from the configured logs directory.
Return recent lines from a log file with optional filtering.
Get the latest persisted backtest run summary for one account.
Preview warnings for a proposed backtest configuration without executing it.
Run a single backtest window and return persisted result metrics including Sharpe, Sortino, Calmar, win rate, profit factor, and average trade return.
List recent backtest runs across accounts.
Get the full backtest report payload for a single run id.
Execute rolling walk-forward windows and return aggregate summary metrics.
List strategy variants and public primitive schemas for the Strategy Lab.
Create a validated draft strategy variant from a public primitive.
Edit a draft strategy variant's knobs and enabled flag (frozen variants reject edits).
Freeze a draft strategy variant so its knobs become immutable and it is tradeable.
List persisted walk-forward optimization evidence and promotion state.
Run a bounded walk-forward optimization with out-of-sample and holdout evidence.
Promote an optimization run's winner into a new strategy variant, optionally frozen.
